name: ttl_lru_cache
issue_title: Key existence check reports expired keys as present
ground_truth_patch:
--- a/src/cache_manager.py
+++ b/src/cache_manager.py
@@ -22,6 +22,10 @@
             return None
         return node.value
 
-    # BUG: contains_key checks index directly without checking expiration!
     def contains_key(self, key: str) -> bool:
-        return key in self.index
+        if key not in self.index:
+            return False
+        if self.index[key].is_expired(time.time()):
+            del self.index[key]
+            return False
+        return True
